title: 第0009章 弑父真相药尊之怒第0010章 迷雾惊魂药尊觉醒
content_zh:
------
林药尘脚步未停。
一步踏出，地面微震。
林啸天连退三步，面如死灰。
“你……你不能杀我！”他嘶吼，声音颤抖。
“我是林家少主！我爹是你伯父！你敢弑亲？！”
林药尘冷笑，眼底寒意如刀。
“伯父？你毒杀他的时候，可曾想过他是你父亲？”
林傲猛然插话，试图转移视线。
“林药尘！休得血口喷人！”
“你若敢动啸天一根汗毛，老夫必让你死无葬身之地！”
林药尘抬眼扫去，气息骤然攀升。
药徒六重巅峰，真气如海啸般压向二人。
林啸天双腿一软，跪倒在地。
“我……我说！我说！”他语无伦次。
“那是……那是三年前的春夜……”
“父亲……林震天……他发现了我和林傲的勾当……”
“我们……我们在他的酒里下了‘断魂草’……”
空气瞬间凝固。
林药尘瞳孔收缩，拳头攥得咯吱作响。

“断魂草……无臭无味，却能慢慢侵蚀心脉。”
“你们竟用这种卑鄙手段，对付自己的亲生父亲！”
林傲脸色铁青，却仍硬着头皮狡辩。
“你懂什么！那是为了林家基业！”
“林震天昏庸无能，迟早会毁了一切！”
林药尘怒极反笑。
“基业？你们这是篡位夺权，还要给自己披上正义的外衣！”
他缓步逼近，真气在周身盘旋。
红蓝二色的气劲如两条游龙，缠绕在双臂之上。
“今日，我要让你们尝尝，什么叫真正的绝望。”
林啸天突然暴起，手中多了一柄暗红匕首。
“就算你强又如何？我还有最后一搏！”
他身形如电，直刺林药尘咽喉！
林药尘只抬右手，轻描淡写地夹住了刀锋。
“就这点本事？”
“咔嚓！”匕首断裂。
林啸天被一拳轰飞，撞断石柱，口中鲜血狂喷。
林傲见状，转身欲逃。
“想走？”林药尘冷哼。
“冰火螺旋劲——天地同寂！”

双掌齐推，红蓝气劲化作巨大的漩涡，瞬间吞噬了林傲的身影。
轰隆——！
content_en:
------
Lin Yaochen's footsteps did not stop.
Taking one step forward, the ground shook slightly.
Lin Xiaotian took three steps back, his face ashen.
"You...you can't kill me!" he roared, his voice trembling.
"I am the young master of the Lin family! My father is your uncle! Do you dare to commit parricide?!"
Lin Yaochen sneered, his eyes as cold as knives.
"Uncle? When you poisoned him, did you ever think that he was your father?"
Lin Ao suddenly interrupted, trying to divert his attention.
"Lin Yaochen! Stop spitting blood!"
"If you dare to touch a hair of Xiaotian, I will let you die without a burial place!"
Lin Yaochen raised his eyes and glanced away, his aura suddenly rising.
At the peak of the sixth level of Medicine Disciple, the true energy pressed against the two of them like a tsunami.
Lin Xiaotian's legs weakened and he fell to his knees.
"I...I said! I said!" He was incoherent.
"That was...that was the spring night three years ago..."
"Father...Lin Zhentian...he discovered what Lin Ao and I were doing..."
"We...we put 'soul-breaking grass' in his wine..."
The air solidified instantly.
Lin Yaochen's pupils shrank and his fists clenched loudly.
"The soul-breaking grass... is odorless and tasteless, but it can slowly erode the heart."
"You actually used such despicable methods to deal with your own biological father!"
Lin Ao's face was ashen, but he still bravely argued.
"What do you know! That's for the Lin family's foundation!"
"Lin Zhentian is incompetent and will ruin everything sooner or later!"
Lin Yaochen laughed in anger.
"Foundation? You are usurping the throne and seizing power, and you want to put on the cloak of justice for yourself!"
He slowly approached, his true energy swirling around him.
The energy of red and blue colors is like two swimming dragons, wrapped around both arms.
"Today, I want to give you a taste of what true despair is."
Lin Xiaotian suddenly burst into flames, with a dark red dagger in his hand.
"So what if you are strong? I still have one last chance!"
His body was like lightning, piercing Lin Yaochen's throat!
Lin Yaochen only raised his right hand and lightly clamped the blade.
"Is that all you have?"
"Crack!" The dagger broke.
Lin Xiaotian was blown away by a punch, breaking a stone pillar, and blood spurted out from his mouth.
Lin Ao saw this and turned around to escape.
"Want to leave?" Lin Yaochen snorted coldly.
"The spiral power of ice and fire - the heaven and the earth are silent!"
Pushing with both palms, the red and blue energy turned into a huge whirlpool, instantly swallowing Lin Ao's figure.
Boom——!
